name: poc-isolated
description: Isolated-runtime host POC: an Angular host loading self-contained web-component MFEs at runtime from a manifest (no federation), plus a framework-agnostic platform SDK for the cross-cutting concerns.

scripts.build:mfes: ng build mfe-orders && ng build mfe-profile
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:mfes && npm run build:ng21 && npm run assemble && ng build host
scripts.start: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:mfes && npm run build:ng21 && npm run assemble && ng serve host
scripts.test:contracts: ngc -p tsconfig.contracts.json && npm --prefix ng21 run test:contracts
